plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the mandate.
Increase QQQI to 15% to favor income and broad index exposure.
Trim CRWD to 10% to cap single name exposure.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation and reduces overall portfolio risk.
conservative.read: This conservative plan targets around 1.5% per month, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and lowering concentration, but also limits potential upside.

plan: Trim SOXL to 3% and SPAL to 2% to reduce leveraged ETF exposure.
Trim SPY to 25% to reduce concentration and meet the mandate.
Increase CRWD to 14% to maintain exposure to quality tech.
Trim QQQI to 10% to slightly reduce income focus.
This plan balances risk and growth, aiming for a more diversified portfolio.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets around 2.5% per month, focusing on risk-first growth. It reduces leverage and concentration while maintaining exposure to quality tech, offering a moderate risk/reward profile.

plan: Increase SOXL to 6% and SPAL to 6% to lean into leveraged ETFs.
Increase CRWD to 14% to concentrate in a high-scoring setup.
Buy TECS at 5% as a new high-scoring setup from the scanner.
Trim SPY to 25% to reduce concentration and meet the mandate.
This plan aims for aggressive growth by using leverage and concentrating in strong setups.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% per month, aiming for stretch growth. It significantly increases both upside and drawdown potential due to higher leverage and concentration. Leveraged ETFs also experience daily decay and rebalancing, which can erode value quickly if not managed with strict stop discipline.

plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure.
Increase QQQI to 30% to prioritize income and monthly distributions.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the mandate.
Trim CRWD to 5% to reduce exposure to high-beta single names.
This plan focuses on generating steady income with lower drawdown.
income.read: This income plan targets around 1% per month, focusing on parking cash for yield. It prioritizes low drawdown and reliable income over growth, but distributions are variable and NAV can still fall in a selloff.
